question:
Select the correct mirror image of the given combination when the mirror is placed at MN as shown below. 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/610db85f536800f8e12b4747c64965165c42e16a65fff793f0a3447091bebc90.png]
solution:
The logic followed here is:

When a mirror is placed vertically to the object, the mirror so formed will be laterally inverted. In other words, the** Left Hand Side** and **Right** **Hand Side** will interchange their position while top and bottom remains same.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/1b2e89981659e3eb816a76863aa2629530820694c2391a3a147cb533776292b5.png] 

Hence, only option(1) shows the correct image.
